# Welcome to the Colossus Radius
Like many others before and after you, you've come to this sector for many things. Be it glory, be it the material riches of the radius, be it war, be it money. You're here for a reason, it's time to get started.
[color=#33bbff]If you'd like a hand, ask on the radio, or talk to somebody.[/color] While things may be confusing in the beginning, the best way to learn is to tag along with somebody who has played the game already. Crewing with a captain is usually a solid source of income, and game knowledge.
## Economy
Any money that you make is [bold]yours[/bold], and will be available in future shifts if deposited at a [color=#44cc00]Bank ATM[/color], found on most POIs (points of interest).
Some ways of making money: - Joining a ship's crew and demanding wages - Purchasing your own ship, mining asteroids, refining ore and selling it for profit - Making and selling fentanyl - Smuggling PDV contraband
## Amenities
Some provisions (e.g. air tanks, salvage equipment) are available from vendors on POIs, but most amenities (medical services, materials, weapons) are offered by other players.
Be sure to stock up at the Trade Depot if going out on an extended voyage, and take advantage of the [color=#33bbff]medical insurance tracker[/color] in your loadout, or from the NanoMed vendor in medbay.
Shifts on the Colossus Sector typically last for [color=#33bbff]six hours[/color]. If you need to end your shift early or take a break, use the [color=#33bbff]cryo sleep chambers[/color] on most POIs.
